chunks: What Muḥammad ibn Aḥmad ibn Yaḥyā narrated from Aḥmad ibn Hilāl, from Yūnus ibn ʿAbd al-Raḥmān, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, who said:
I said to Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام: May a man perform any part of the obligatory prayer while riding? He said: No, except in a case of necessity.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man, meaning the legally responsible worshipper
key_terms.ضَرُورَةٍ: a necessity that permits exception to the normal ruling

ai.seo_question: Can a person perform an obligatory salat (prayer) while riding an animal?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling that obligatory salat (prayer) is not to be performed while riding, except in a state of necessity. It indicates the importance of fulfilling the prescribed conditions of obligatory worship unless a genuine constraint exists.
